questions.stem: A newborn presents with weakness in the right arm, inability to abduct the shoulder or flex the elbow, and the arm is held in internal rotation with the forearm pronated. Which of the following best describes the pathophysiology of this condition?
questions.stemHtml: A newborn presents with weakness in the right arm, inability to abduct the shoulder or flex the elbow, and the arm is held in internal rotation with the forearm pronated. Which of the following best describes the pathophysiology of this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Injury to the lower trunk of the brachial plexus (C8-T1)

options.label: B
options.text: Compression of the median nerve at the carpal tunnel

options.label: C
options.text: Injury to the upper trunk of the brachial plexus (C5-C6)

options.label: D
options.text: Avulsion of the cervical nerve roots from the spinal cord
